finding: Current evidence supports the hypothesis that declaration-only TypedIR can collapse semantically distinct frontend statements and that content-addressed residual-semantic preservation repairs tested identity loss without reparsing or authority minting. The strongest remaining counterhypothesis is downstream semantic stranding.
counterhypotheses: Identity preservation does not imply executable semantic correctness.
Some residual classes may be metadata-only and should not be lowered into evaluator operations.
The tested Ubuntu executions share implementation and fixture ancestry and therefore do not provide independent replication.
